title: Find Five Textures
summary: Notice five different textures in a safe room without collecting anything.
safety_notes: Stay in the agreed safe area
Do not touch hot, sharp, electrical or fragile objects
Do not taste or collect unknown items
steps: Choose a safe room with an adult
Notice five surfaces that look or feel different
Describe each as smooth, rough, soft or bumpy
Tell someone which texture surprised you
accessibility: Children who prefer not to touch can observe visually
alternatives: Use pictures of textures if moving around is not possible
